name: foundry-mcp
description: Read and edit your Foundry VTT world: scenes, journals, folders and images.
long_description: Connects Claude to a Foundry VTT v14 world through the JT Foundry MCP Bridge module, which runs in the GM's browser tab. Install the module from https://github.com/jukkaturunen/foundry-mcp/releases/latest/download/module.json and put the same token in its settings.

token.title: Token
token.description: A secret of at least 16 characters. Put the same value in Foundry: Configure Settings → JT Foundry MCP Bridge.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port the Foundry module connects to. Change only if you changed it in the module too.
